title: Susie
transcription:
Susie

Where, oh where, oh where is Susie?
Where, oh where, oh where is Susie?
Where, oh where, oh where is Susie?
Way down yonder in the paw-paw patch.

Chorus:
Pickin' up paw-paws
puttin' 'em in the basket.
Pickin' up paw-paws
puttin' 'em in the basket.
Pickin' up paw-paws
puttin' 'em in the basket.
Way down yonder
in the paw-paw patch.

Other verses:
Come on boys, lets go find her...
Oh garsh ain't she ugly...
But she can do the Hula-hula...
We got married and had ten children...
Five was ugly and five could hula...
